articles.title: Saudi Arabia Accelerates $13.3 Billion Indoor Entertainment Center Buildout
articles.summary: Saudi Arabia is intensifying a massive $13.3 billion investment in indoor entertainment centers as part of its Vision 2030 diversification push. The scale of this buildout represents one of the largest single-market opportunities for FEC suppliers, attraction manufacturers, and operators in history. Companies looking to expand internationally should be paying close attention to procurement pipelines and partnership opportunities in the Kingdom.

articles.title: Lucky Strike Entertainment Posts $1.25B Revenue for FY2026, Still Unprofitable
articles.summary: Lucky Strike Entertainment Corp reported full-year revenue of $1.25 billion for fiscal 2026 but recorded a loss of $0.33 per share, according to its 10-K filing. The results offer a key benchmark for the bowling-anchored FEC segment, illustrating strong top-line scale alongside ongoing profitability challenges. Operators and investors in the competitive socializing and upscale bowling space should study these financials closely.

articles.title: Slick City Reinvents the Indoor Slide Park, Expands to Europe with 40+ US Locations
articles.summary: Slick City Action Park, a dry-slide concept with over 40 US locations, has opened its first European venue in Nottingham, UK, featuring 16 high-speed slides and a new UV AirGlider aerial attraction. CEO Bron Launsby, a trampoline park veteran, discusses how continuous adaptation and category creation have fueled rapid growth. The brand's international expansion signals that dry-slide parks may be the next major FEC format to go global.

articles.title: Game Volt Launches Battle Arcade: Multiplayer LED Floor Attraction Targeting FECs
articles.summary: Game Volt has released Battle Arcade, an interactive LED floor attraction featuring 10+ multiplayer games on a full-color, full-graphic display designed for FECs, arcades, and competitive socializing venues. The system supports up to six players per session, is designed for high throughput, and the manufacturer claims ROI in under six months. The expandable game library and immersive visuals differentiate it from basic illuminated floor products already on the market.

articles.title: Skyline Social & Games Opens 100,000 Sq Ft FEC in Minnesota with Intercard Cashless System
articles.summary: Skyline Social & Games in Apple Valley, Minnesota has launched a nearly 100,000-square-foot indoor and outdoor family entertainment center, selecting Intercard's cashless technology to power its arcade operations. The venue is operated by the Kolquist family, experienced bowling center operators expanding into the broader FEC format. The project is a strong case study in scaling from single-concept bowling to full-service FEC.

articles.title: Minnesota Bowling Centers Reinvent Themselves as Full-Service FECs
articles.summary: A Twin Cities Business feature examines how bowling businesses across Minnesota are evolving beyond lanes to incorporate arcades, dining, bars, and other entertainment formats to drive year-round revenue. The trend reflects a broader industry shift as standalone bowling faces headwinds from changing consumer habits. The article provides useful competitive intelligence for operators considering diversification strategies.

articles.title: Valo Motion to Unveil New 'Groundfall' Attraction at IAAPA Expo Europe
articles.summary: Valo Motion, maker of popular active gaming attractions like ValoClimb and ValoJump, will launch its new Groundfall product at IAAPA Expo Europe. The announcement is significant for FEC buyers attending the expo who are scouting the latest in interactive floor and active gaming technology. Valo Motion's track record of strong FEC placement makes this a product to watch.

articles.title: Launch Family Entertainment Signs Lease for First Montana Location
articles.summary: Launch Family Entertainment has signed a lease for its first location in Montana, continuing the trampoline park and FEC chain's geographic expansion across the US. The move signals continued investor confidence in the Launch brand as it fills white-space markets. Operators watching Launch's expansion cadence will find this useful for competitive mapping.

articles.title: Launch Family Entertainment Converts Former Dillard's Department Store in Denton, Texas
articles.summary: Launch Family Entertainment is transforming a former Dillard's department store in Denton, Texas into a full FEC venue set to open this fall. The adaptive reuse of dead retail space is a growing strategy for FEC operators seeking large square footage at competitive lease rates. This project is a practical example of the retail-to-FEC conversion playbook that operators and investors should follow closely.

articles.title: Texas' Largest Family Entertainment Center Opens in Houston in 2026
articles.summary: What is being billed as Texas' biggest family entertainment center has opened in Houston in 2026, adding a major new competitor to one of the country's most active FEC markets. The venue's scale and offerings underscore the ongoing arms race among large-format FEC operators in high-growth Sun Belt cities. Houston-area operators should assess the competitive impact on their own attendance and pricing.

articles.title: Dave & Buster's Strengthens Executive Team to Drive Growth and Innovation
articles.summary: Dave & Buster's has announced additions to its executive leadership team aimed at accelerating growth, operational excellence, and innovation across its entertainment dining portfolio. Leadership changes at the industry's dominant FEC-dining chain are always closely watched as indicators of strategic direction. The move suggests the brand is positioning for an active expansion or concept refresh cycle.

articles.title: SEVEN Tabuk Opens with Cyber Bowling, Indoor Golf, and More Days After SEVEN Abha Launch
articles.summary: SEVEN, Saudi Arabia's entertainment development company, has opened venues in both Tabuk and Abha within days of each other, with offerings including cyber bowling and indoor golf. The rapid multi-city rollout illustrates the pace of Saudi Arabia's entertainment infrastructure buildout. FEC suppliers and attraction manufacturers should note SEVEN as a major procurement target in the region.

articles.title: Mr. Gatti's Pizza Eyes Franchise Return to Lubbock with New FEC Concept
articles.summary: Mr. Gatti's Pizza is targeting a return to Lubbock, Texas, with a new family entertainment center concept that pairs its classic pizza brand with expanded entertainment offerings. The move reflects a broader trend of legacy pizza-and-games brands revitalizing through updated FEC formats. Franchisees interested in established brand recognition combined with an entertainment-first model should take note.

articles.title: Slick City Action Park Projects Fall Opening at New Humble, Texas Location
articles.summary: Slick City Action Park is on track for a fall 2026 opening at its Humble, Texas location, adding another US venue to its rapidly growing dry-slide park portfolio. The Texas market continues to be a hotbed for new FEC openings given its population growth and consumer spending. Operators in the Houston metro should factor this new competitor into their planning.

articles.title: IAAPA Announces 2026 Hall of Fame Inductees Ahead of Orlando Expo
articles.summary: IAAPA has revealed its 2026 Hall of Fame inductees, who will be officially honored during IAAPA Expo 2026 in Orlando, Florida. The Hall of Fame recognition highlights individuals who have made lasting contributions to the attractions industry. This is a notable networking and industry culture moment for FEC operators and suppliers attending the expo.

articles.title: Bergen County FEC Auction Features Trampolines, Bowling Lanes, and VR Arena Equipment
articles.summary: A large family entertainment center in Bergen County, New Jersey is being liquidated at auction, with assets including trampolines, bowling lanes, and a virtual reality arena up for bid. Auctions like this present buying opportunities for operators looking to acquire quality equipment at below-market prices. They also serve as cautionary data points about the challenges of operating large-format FECs in competitive markets.

articles.title: WhiteWater Debuts Helix Twist, a New Water Slide Feature Creating Rotation Sensation
articles.summary: WhiteWater has introduced Helix Twist, a new slide feature that uses changing geometry to create the perception that the slide is rotating around the rider. The innovation adds a novel sensory experience to traditional water slides without requiring riders to spin, broadening the appeal for water park and indoor waterpark operators. Product launches from WhiteWater are closely watched by aquatic attraction buyers worldwide.

articles.title: Jersey Shore Drugstore Site to Be Redeveloped as Family Entertainment Center
articles.summary: A long-vacant drugstore on the Jersey Shore is set to be converted into a family entertainment center, continuing the trend of repurposing retail and commercial real estate for FEC use. The project demonstrates how FEC operators are finding opportunities in communities underserved by entertainment options. Local operators and developers should monitor similar vacant retail corridors as potential FEC sites.

articles.title: Fantasy Island Breaks Ground on New FEC at Former Ship Bottom, NJ CVS Location
articles.summary: Fantasy Island has begun construction on a new entertainment center at a former CVS drugstore site in Ship Bottom, New Jersey, a shore community with strong seasonal tourism. The project represents another example of adaptive retail reuse for FEC development. It also expands Fantasy Island's footprint beyond its existing amusement park operation.

articles.title: Lake Compounce Appoints New General Manager with 25 Years of Attraction Industry Experience
articles.summary: Lake Compounce, America's oldest amusement park, has named Daniel LLanas as its new General Manager, bringing over 25 years of theme park, water park, and destination attraction leadership experience to the role. Leadership transitions at established regional parks often signal strategic shifts in operations or capital investment. FEC operators can look to LLanas's background for insight into the skills increasingly valued at the GM level.

articles.title: Happitat Bangkok Opens 200,000 Sq M Mixed-Use Destination with Immersive Entertainment
articles.summary: Happitat has opened in Bangkok as a large-scale mixed-use destination blending retail, dining, nature, and immersive digital entertainment across more than 200,000 square meters. The development includes a dedicated children and family zone, an entertainment hub, and interactive digital forest experiences. The project is a leading international example of experience-led retail destinations that FEC operators and developers can study for format inspiration.

articles.title: Six Flags to Move Corporate Headquarters to Arlington, Texas by March 2027
articles.summary: Six Flags Entertainment Corporation is relocating its corporate headquarters from Charlotte, North Carolina to Arlington, Texas, home to five of its parks and existing corporate office space at Choctaw Stadium. The move is expected to be complete by March 2027 and places leadership closer to the company's largest regional cluster. This signals a continued strategic focus on the Texas market and operational consolidation for the post-merger entity.

articles.title: Six Flags Fiesta Texas Breaks Ground on Werewolf Gorge, Future World's Longest Family Launch Coaster
articles.summary: Six Flags Fiesta Texas has broken ground on Werewolf Gorge, a 4,120-foot family launch coaster billed as the world's longest of its kind and the largest single-attraction investment in the park's history. The coaster is scheduled to debut during the park's 35th anniversary season in 2027. Large capital investments by major regional parks set competitive benchmarks that smaller FEC operators in surrounding markets must account for.

articles.title: Tornado Terry's Amusement Center Turns to GoFundMe as a Last Resort to Stay Open
articles.summary: Tornado Terry's Family Amusement Center in the Keller-Roanoke area of Northeast Fort Worth has launched a GoFundMe campaign in a bid to avoid permanent closure. The story highlights the financial fragility that many small, independent FEC operators face, particularly in the face of rising costs and competition from larger venues. It serves as a cautionary tale and a conversation starter about sustainable business models for community-focused amusement centers.

articles.title: Six Flags St. Louis Rebrands as Mid America Adventure
articles.summary: Six Flags St. Louis has officially rebranded to Mid America Adventure, unveiling a new name, logo, and brand identity that honors the park's 55-year history in the Midwest. The rebrand is part of a broader strategy by Six Flags to differentiate regional parks and strengthen local identity following its merger with Cedar Fair. Regional FEC competitors should monitor how the refreshed brand positioning affects attendance and marketing in the St. Louis market.

articles.title: Dollywood Mourns the Passing of Co-Owner Dolly Parton at Age 80
articles.summary: Dolly Parton, the country music icon and co-owner of Dollywood theme park in Pigeon Forge, Tennessee, has passed away at the age of 80. Dollywood, which Parton co-owns with Herschend Family Entertainment, issued a statement confirming the park will remain open and honoring her legacy. The passing of such a central figure raises questions about brand continuity and future leadership direction for one of the most beloved regional theme parks in the US.

articles.title: Universal's Halloween Horror Nights 35 Introduces 'Deathly Afraid' Necklace for Guests Wanting Limited Scares
articles.summary: Universal Orlando's Halloween Horror Nights 35 will offer guests a 'Deathly Afraid' necklace that signals scare actors to provide a reduced-intensity experience. The initiative is a notable accessibility and inclusivity move that allows venues to serve a broader audience during high-demand seasonal events. FEC operators running haunted attractions or Halloween events can adapt this concept to make their events more welcoming to anxious guests and families with younger children.

articles.title: Calypso's Cove Adds Real JCB Mini Excavator Guest Experience
articles.summary: Calypso's Cove in Old Forge, New York has added a guest-operated mini excavator experience using real JCB equipment sourced from sister park Diggerland USA. The attraction broadens the park's offering for younger guests and families seeking hands-on, novelty experiences beyond traditional rides. Digger-style experiences have proven strong performers at FECs and children's entertainment venues seeking differentiated attraction mixes.
